bodyHtml:
MEGA-160 High-Pressure Booster Tank

160-Liter (44 Gallon) 16-Bar Pressure Tank for High-Rise & Long-Distance Water Systems | Aquasky MEGA-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

MEGA-160 is a pressurized water system component designed for high-rise buildings, fire systems, and demanding long-distance pressure support. With a 160-liter (44-gallon) capacity, it reliably maintains water pressure at a set, consistent level.

 

Built for high-stress environments, this tank supports a robust maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. It is factory-pre-charged with 100% nitrogen to ensure stable performance and prevent pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes.

 

Measuring 55.0 cm in diameter and 92.7 cm in height, the tank includes a heavy-duty base for added stability. It is an ideal high-capacity solution for residential and commercial booster setups requiring exceptional high-pressure performance and flow rates.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The MEGA-160 is a 160-liter (44-gallon) high-performance diaphragm tank, engineered as the premier solution for mid-to-large scale water system stabilization. Utilizing a specialized FDA-grade polypropylene liner integrated with a premium butyl diaphragm, it ensures a dedicated "Safe Water Zone" by preventing any contact between the liquid and the tank's metallic shell.

Key technical advantages include a 100% Nitrogen pre-charge and a 16-bar (232 PSI) pressure rating, which significantly outperforms standard industry tanks. This configuration ensures more stable pressure cycles and minimizes pump "short-cycling," directly preventing motor burnout and extending equipment lifespan. 

Constructed with a heavy-duty cold-rolled carbon steel shell and protected by a triple-grade epoxy powder finish, the MEGA-160 offers superior oxidation resistance. Equipped with a 1-1/4” Stainless Steel lead-free connector, this CE and ISO 9001 certified unit provides an energy-saving, maintenance-free solution for critical high-pressure applications.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • 16-Bar high-pressure rating for high-rise buildings and long-distance pipelines.
  • Cold-rolled carbon steel shell offers exceptional structural integrity under extreme pressure.
  • 304 stainless steel connection ensures secure, rust-free, durable integration.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands frequent cycling and maintains constant pressure.
  • Triple-grade blue paint coating provides superior exterior protection.
  • 100% Nitrogen pre-charged to prevent pressure loss common with compressed air.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the MEGA-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The MEGA-160 stores supplemental water between the liner and the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm. When a faucet is opened or an appliance demands water, the compressed nitrogen air chamber pushes the stored water into the system. This allows the system to meet low-volume water demands without immediately triggering the pump motor. By creating this efficient supply cycle, the tank minimizes pump cycling, stabilizes water pressure, and conserves energy.

Key benefits

  • Provides ideal high-pressure delivery for high-rise buildings and long-distance applications
  • Extends equipment life by reducing pump starts and preventing motor burnout
  • Guarantees robust, stable water flow for showers, washers, and dishwashers
  • Zero maintenance required, saving time and servicing costs

Typical Applications

  • High-rise building water supply networks
  • Long-distance water pressure support systems
  • Fire systems, water jets, and water machining (25L per minute flow rate applications)
  • Large-scale residential and commercial booster pump systems

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : I need a 160-liter tank. What flow rate does the MEGA-160 offer, and where is it manufactured?

The MEGA-160 provides a 25L per minute flow rate and, like all MEGA-PLUS tanks, is 100% made in Taiwan in an ISO9001-certified facility.
 

Q2 : How does the Nitrogen pre-charge in the MEGA-160 protect the tank internally?

Standard compressed air contains oxygen, which causes internal oxidation (rusting) of the carbon steel shell over time. AQUASKY's 100% Nitrogen pre-charge completely removes oxygen from the air chamber, ensuring the tank remains entirely rust-free internally.

Q3 : What is the empty weight and shipping volume of the MEGA-160?

The MEGA-160 has a net weight of 30.7 kg (67.7 lbs) and requires a shipping volume of 10.04 CUF.
